before: Only a CJK face with a one-em box takes a line of 1.3 times its box.
after: A taller CJK face that draws as the family the run names also takes 1.3 times its own box; stand-ins and glyph fallbacks keep their own box. A hinted character the East Asian face has no glyph for takes the Latin slot in layout.
reason: Only line measurement changes. Shared nodes, text offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged.
